label: Fantasy Premier League
notes:
Link is for FPL Roddy League.
Premier League and Championship H2H leagues will also be run via Side League sheet, as well as FPL Cup
rules: FPL RULES RODDY All weekly scores will be taken from the official Fantasy Premier League site, the table will follow whatever is listed on the official league page HEAD TO HEAD LEAGUES There will be no on-site Head-to-Head leagues run, these will be run internally on the sheet. Fixtures for Round 1 will be drawn via wheel spins, with the remainder of the draw using the Supercoach fixturing procedure. For eligibility to enter H2H leagues, one of the following must be true: - player is in an eliza chat (discord/messenger), activity irrelevant - player played in an Eliza A-League H2H comp the season prior FPL CUP Entry: All league teams are automatically entered. Platform: Hosted and tracked on Challonge. Link will be provided on Eliza website Schedule: Starts in Gameweek 3 and runs every 2 weeks. Blank and Double Gameweeks are skipped. Stage 1: Swiss Group Stage (Rounds 1–6) Round 1 Draw: Fixtures are seeded using GW2 standings (Top Half vs. Bottom Half—1st plays 17th, 2nd plays 18th, etc.). Rounds 2–6: You will be paired against a team with the same tournament record as you (e.g., 2–0 vs. 2–0). Stage 2: Double Elimination Knockout Bracket Top16 teams from the group stage advance to a Double Elimination bracket. Top 8 will enter the Winners Bracket, 9-16 will enter the Losers Bracket Win and you stay in the Winners Bracket. Lose once and you drop into the Losers Bracket for a second chance. Lose in the Losers Bracket and you are knocked out. Grand Final: The Winners Bracket champion faces the Losers Bracket champion for the title. As the Winners Bracket champion would still have a loss in hand, the Losers Bracket champion must beat the Winners Bracket champion twice to take the title.

label: Australia Cup LMS
rules: LAST MAN STANDING RULES The aim of the game is to choose a winner from each round of the competition All tips must be unique for every round until the final - you cannot repeat a team unless you have survived until the final. At any stage before the final if you have previously selected all remaining teams in the competition, you will be eliminated If all remaining players are eliminated together before the final round, all teams will move on to the next round. Once you get a prediction incorrect you are eliminated. If a tip is not entered before deadline, a random pick will be chosen via wheel spinner on discord Once the tournament reaches the final round, all remaining players are free to pick any of the final teams, however will also need to answer the following tie-breaker questions to determine a winner. - First Goalscorer - Minute of First goal You must pick at least 1 NPL team in either Phase 1 or Phase 2 of the Round of 32. AUSTRALIA CUP LMS FORMAT ROUND OF 32 - 2 PHASES - MUST TIP IN BOTH PHASES. Phase 1 - 22/7 - 27/7 Phase 2 - 29/7-30/7 ROUND OF 16 QUARTER FINALS SEMI FINALS FINAL
